newsitem.title: INDIA: India allows Nynex unit to raise stake.
newsitem.headline: India allows Nynex unit to raise stake.

text.p: The Indian government said on Friday it approved a proposal by a unit of U.S. telecommunications firm Nynex Corp to raise its stake in India's Reliance Telecom to $26.2 million.
Currently the Nynex unit, called Nynex International (India) Ltd, has a 50,000 rupee ($1,400) stake in the joint venture.
Nynex owns 10 percent of Reliance Telecom's equity capital, which currently totals 500,000 rupees.
The joint venture has proposed raising its equity capital base to $262 million, the government statement said.
Of the total equity, $126 million will be held by foreign stakeholders including the Nynex unit, it said.
Shares not held by the Nynex unit will be placed with foreign institutional investors, foreign financial institutions, multinational agencies and other investors, it said.
Reliance Telecom has been granted licenses to set up cellular telephone networks in seven Indian states.
Reliance Telecom forecasts total capital outlay of 18.36 billion rupees over four years in the seven states, the statement said. The project cost will be funded equally by debt and equity, it said.
